candidates.cp_b_title_en: Real-time and Batch Screening: Types and Purposes

cp_a.title_zh: 负面媒体筛查：定义与要求
cp_a.title_en: Adverse Media Screening: Definition and Mandate
cp_a.reason: Defines adverse media checks and mandates a risk-based approach.

units.zh: 负面媒体检查（不良新闻筛查）用于识别与金融犯罪风险相关的公开信息
units.en: Adverse media checks—also known as negative news screening— identify publicly available information linking individuals or entities to financial crime risks.

units.zh: 金融机构须对负面媒体筛查采取基于风险的方法，确保准确可信
units.en: With the increasing de-escalation of fact-checking on social media platforms, and the rise of automated software-as-a-service screening solutions, financial institutions must take a risk-based approach to adverse media screening, ensuring accurate and credible risk assessments.

cp_b.title_zh: 实时与批量筛查：类型与目的
cp_b.title_en: Real-time and Batch Screening: Types and Purposes
cp_b.reason: Human review accepted the P2A boundary after checking the section-level review topic.

units.zh: 持续筛查分为实时筛查和批量筛查两种类型，各有其用途
units.en: There are typically two types of screening: Real-time screening and batch screening. Each serves its own purpose.

units.zh: 实时筛查在支付发生时进行，有助于防止涉及受制裁个人或实体的交易
units.en: Real-time screening involves screening payments as they happen, which helps prevent payments involving sanctioned individuals or entities.

units.zh: 批量筛查是对机构整个客户群进行制裁和恐怖名单筛查的过程
units.en: Batch screening is a process of screening the organization’s entire customer base against sanctions and terror lists.

units.zh: 支付系统中的持续筛查对于预防和检测洗钱、恐怖融资和制裁规避至关重要
units.en: Ongoing screening in payment systems is critical for preventing and detecting financial crimes, including money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions evasion.

units.zh: 未能阻止受制裁交易会使企业面临严重的监管处罚、声誉损害和法律后果
units.en: Failing to prevent such transactions can put any business at risk for severe regulatory penalties, reputational damage, and legal consequences.

units.zh: 违反制裁法规可能导致美国OFAC或英国OFSI等监管机构处以巨额罚款
units.en: Noncompliance with sanctions regulations can result in heavy fines imposed by regulatory bodies such as the OFAC in the US or OFSI in the UK.

units.zh: 机构在客户准入时作为了解你的客户检查的一部分，应实时筛查客户是否涉及制裁或恐怖名单
units.en: When an organization onboards a customer, as part of its KYC checks it should screen the customer in real time against sanctions or terror lists.

units.zh: 若客户被识别为政治敏感人物，机构可能需要进行额外的尽职调查
units.en: If the customer is identified as a PEP, the organization may need to conduct additional due diligence.

units.zh: 机构还会针对特定观察名单和政治敏感人物名单进行筛查
units.en: Organizations also screen customers against specific watch lists and PEP lists.

units.zh: 对现有客户进行批量筛查是必要的，因为客户可能在准入后被列入制裁或观察名单
units.en: Batch screening of existing customers is necessary because a customer may have been added to a sanctions or watch list since being onboarded. The only way an organization can know about the customer’s change in status is by batch screening.

units.zh: 实时筛查用于立即拦截支付，批量筛查用于识别已列入制裁或观察名单的现有客户
units.en: Organizations use both real-time and batch screening because they serve different purposes. Real-time screening is necessary for payments that organizations must detect and block immediately. Batch screening identifies existing customers who have been added to sanctions or watch lists.

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Organizational setup for law enforcement communication
candidates.cp_b_title_en: Cooperation and information sharing among authorities

cp_a.title_zh: 与执法部门沟通的组织设置
cp_a.title_en: Organizational setup for law enforcement communication
cp_a.reason: These two units both describe organizational practices—designating a point of contact and having written procedures—forming a single review point about communication setup.

units.zh: 大多数组织指定专人作为与执法部门的联络点。
units.en: Most organizations designate a specific person to serve as the point of contact with law enforcement.

units.zh: 组织应制定书面程序，规定如何回应执法部门的正式信息请求。
units.en: Organizations should have written procedures that address how to communicate with law enforcement when responding to formal requests for information.

cp_b.title_zh: 机构间的合作与信息共享
cp_b.title_en: Cooperation and information sharing among authorities
cp_b.reason: Emphasizes the importance of cooperation, information sharing, and the various models and channels.

units.zh: 各机构必须合作并共享与各自职能相关的信息
units.en: There are many different models, but the main point is that the agencies cooperate and share information when it pertains to each other’s functions.

units.zh: 同一机构可同时承担监管机构、金融情报机构和执法机构的角色
units.en: In some cases, the same organization can be both a regulator and an FIU, and FIUs can also be part of law enforcement agencies.

units.zh: 机构应与国际同行共享信息以打击跨境洗钱和恐怖融资
units.en: These agencies should also share information with their international counterparts to handle crossborder money laundering and terrorist financing.

units.zh: 信息共享渠道因信息类型（情报、证据或监管信息）而异
units.en: There are various channels for information sharing, depending on whether it is intelligence, evidence, or regulatory information.

cp_a.title_zh: 政治敏感人物筛查的外包
cp_a.reason: Rule: organizations must follow proper outsourcing procedures and retain risk ownership.

units.zh: 使用第三方政治敏感人物供应商时须遵循外包程序，风险仍由机构承担
units.en: Many organizations select a third-party vendor to provide information about potential PEPs. When this happens, organizations should follow appropriate outsourcing procedures, because the outsourcing organization continues to own the risk.

cp_b.reason: Groups two distinct but complementary roles: establishing security protocols and driving data innovation for competitive advantage.

units.zh: 委员会与IT和网络安全团队合作建立数据保护安全协议
units.en: Committees work closely with IT and cybersecurity teams to establish security protocols for data protection, preventing breaches, cyber threats, and unauthorized access.

units.zh: 委员会战略性地监督数据创新，帮助组织获得竞争优势
units.en: In a more strategic role, they oversee the use of data for innovation. In this role, they help the organization achieve a competitive advantage by identifying valuable trends, improving customer risk assessments, and optimizing detection performance across internal business units.

cp_a.reason: Describes the OECD Anti-Bribery Convention, its requirements, monitoring mechanism, and the Working Group.

units.zh: 1997年11月，OECD通过了《打击在国际商业交易中贿赂外国公职人员公约》。
units.en: In November 1997, the OECD adopted the Convention on Combating Bribery of Foreign Public Officials in International Business Transactions.

units.zh: 该公约要求签署国立法将贿赂外国公职人员定为刑事犯罪。
units.en: The Convention requires signatory countries to establish legislation that criminalizes the bribery of foreign public officials in international business transactions.

units.zh: 公约建立了开放、同行驱动的监督机制以确保国际义务的全面实施。
units.en: It also establishes an open-ended, peer-driven monitoring mechanism to ensure the thorough implementation of international obligations.

units.zh: 该公约是首个也是唯一一个聚焦贿赂交易“供应方”的国际反腐败文书。
units.en: It is the first and only international anti-corruption instrument focused on the “supply side” of the bribery transaction: the person or entity offering, promising, or giving a bribe.

units.zh: OECD贿赂工作组评估并建议各司法管辖区实施和执行公约的情况，发布详细报告。
units.en: The OECD Working Group on Bribery in International Business Transactions evaluates and makes recommendations on a jurisdiction’s implementation and enforcement of the Convention and related instruments. The Working Group issues reports that detail a jurisdiction’s achievements and challenges, including enforcement of foreign bribery offenses. The reports also document the jurisdiction’s progress since its last evaluation.

cp_b.title_zh: ESG与反洗钱/反恐怖融资交叉领域
cp_b.reason: Highlights three areas where ESG intersects with AML/CFT: environmental crime, social impact, governance and compliance.

units.zh: 环境犯罪涉及违反环保规则和非法采矿，常伴随贿赂和腐败
units.en: Environmental crime: This includes, for example, noncompliance with antipollution rules to achieve economic benefits or the exploitation of illegal mining. Financial crime such as bribery and corruption of local officials might be involved as part of the enterprise.

units.zh: 社会影响包括强迫劳动和腐败以实现商业目标
units.en: Social impact: This includes the exploitation of forced labor and corruption to achieve business objectives.

units.zh: 治理失败导致未能预防金融犯罪，全球监管执法行动已显示其影响
units.en: Governance and compliance: This includes governance failures that result in a failure to prevent financial crime within organizations; regulatory enforcement actions all over the world have demonstrated their impact.

units.zh: ESG法规趋势与反洗钱/反恐怖融资交叉领域概述
units.en: Although ESG regulations vary across jurisdictions, trends include increased mandatory disclosure, accountability, and transparency in organizational practices. The scope of ESG ranges from climate change to corporate governance to human rights. ESG considerations intersect with AML/CFT with respect to:

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Research and Due Diligence Steps for Charities and NGOs
candidates.cp_b_title_en: Ongoing Due Diligence and Periodic KYC Reviews

cp_a.title_zh: 慈善机构和非政府组织的研究与尽职调查步骤
cp_a.title_en: Research and Due Diligence Steps for Charities and NGOs
cp_a.reason: outlines key actions: verify registration, tax-exempt status, tax returns, and consult unbiased evaluations

units.zh: 研究慈善机构时应查询注册机构、免税状态和税务申报
units.en: While researching charities and NGOs, be sure to search the relevant registration authorities to confirm their exempt status and their annual tax return filings. Also, consult websites that provide unbiased evaluations of charities and NGOs. It is likely that larger organizations will have a list of approved websites to conduct this research.

cp_b.title_zh: 持续尽职调查与定期KYC审查
cp_b.title_en: Ongoing Due Diligence and Periodic KYC Reviews
cp_b.reason: Human review accepted the P2A boundary after checking the section-level review topic.

units.zh: 持续尽职调查的定义：确保金融机构定期更新客户风险评估、监控交易并识别可疑行为
units.en: Ongoing due diligence is a process that ensures financial institutions regularly update customer risk assessments, monitor customer transactions, and identify suspicious behavior to maintain compliance with AFC regulations.

units.zh: 持续尽职调查的关键监控机制包括定期了解你的客户审查、触发事件审查、实时支付筛查等
units.en: Ongoing due diligence consists of several critical monitoring mechanisms, including periodic KYC reviews, trigger event reviews, real-time payment screening, batch screening, perpetual KYC, and advanced compliance technologies.

units.zh: 定期了解你的客户审查：根据客户风险等级定期更新客户信息、所有权结构、业务活动和风险分类
units.en: Periodic KYC reviews take place at regular intervals, based on the customer’s risk level. Financial institutions must review and update customer information, ownership structures, business activities, and risk classifications. For example:

units.zh: 持续尽职调查与开户时客户尽职调查的区别：前者是应对风险变化的动态过程
units.en: Unlike the customer due diligence undertaken at onboarding, ongoing due diligence is an evolving process that responds to risk changes, financial crime threats, and regulatory developments.

units.zh: 高风险客户通常每年审查一次
units.en: High-risk customers are typically reviewed annually.

units.zh: 中风险客户通常每两到三年审查一次
units.en: Medium-risk customers are typically reviewed every two to three years.

cp_a.reason: Covers the UN sanctions legal basis, obligation, monitoring, and the Consolidated List as a single review topic.

units.zh: 联合国依据《联合国宪章》第七章第41条使用制裁促进国际和平与安全
units.en: The UN uses sanctions to promote international peace and security. This power is based on Article 41 of Chapter VII of the UN Charter.

units.zh: 联合国会员国有义务接受并执行安理会制裁决定
units.en: Article 25 further states that Member States are obligated to “accept and carry out the decisions of the Security Council.”

units.zh: 安理会通过决议后，联合国设立制裁委员会监督实施
units.en: After the Security Council passes a resolution, the UN establishes a sanctions committee to monitor the implementation and effectiveness of a sanctions regime.

units.zh: 联合国安理会综合清单列明所有受制裁的个人和实体
units.en: The UN also maintains the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, which includes all persons and entities that are subject to UN sanctions.

cp_b.reason: All three key takeaway points relate to sanctions evasion and its connection to money laundering, forming a single review topic.

units.zh: 制裁规避可作为洗钱的上游犯罪，体现金融犯罪的关联性
units.en: Sanctions evasion can serve as a predicate offense for money laundering, highlighting the interconnected nature of financial crimes.

units.zh: 犯罪分子利用壳公司掩盖非法活动并规避制裁
units.en: Criminals might use shell companies to mask illicit activities and circumvent sanctions restrictions.

units.zh: 复杂金融策略可掩盖核武器开发等被禁活动
units.en: Complex financial strategies can obscure prohibited activities such as nuclear weapons development.

units.zh: 受制裁个人或实体是电汇风险的红旗信号

units.zh: 电汇金额或数量异常是风险指标

cp_b.title_zh: 恐怖分子利用传统银行渠道和代理行红旗信号
cp_b.title_en: Terrorist use of traditional banking channels and correspondent banking red flags
cp_b.reason: Covers the general factors (257-258) driving terrorist financing choices, the rule for banks (259), and specific banking channels (260) with the example of correspondent banking (261) and its red flag (262), forming a coherent review point on traditional banking risks.

units.zh: 银行应全面了解客户及其交易性质以应对恐怖融资风险
units.en: Because of the exploitative nature of terrorism financing, banks should have a comprehensive understanding of their customers and the nature of their transactions.

units.zh: 恐怖组织可能利用传统银行系统、合法货币服务企业和现金转移和存储资金
units.en: Terrorist organizations could use the traditional banking system, along with legitimate money service businesses, and cash to move and store funds.

units.zh: 代理行是不同司法管辖区银行间实现金融交易的业务模式
units.en: For example, correspondent banking is a business model that makes financial transactions possible between unrelated banks in different jurisdictions.

units.zh: 通过嵌套交易识别恐怖融资红旗信号信号
units.en: It also makes possible a red flag for terrorism financing, through nested transactions in which funds could be paid to unrelated third parties or in lines of business different than the customer of record.

units.zh: 恐怖分子选择资金转移和存储方式时考虑交易规模、速度和检测风险
units.en: Terrorists and terrorist organizations have many options when choosing to move and store funds between jurisdictions. The choice depends on numerous variables. These variables include the size of the transaction, how quickly the transaction needs to be performed, and the risks of detection for the organization and its financial facilitators.

units.zh: 恐怖分子会滥用任何可用的渠道和方法转移和存储资金
units.en: Whether it is through trade, commerce, or outside of the financial system, terrorists will seek to abuse any channel and method available to them.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: SAFS case: AML/CFT failures due to outdated EWRA

cp_a.reason: Penalties for failing to file a SAR, with a concluding reminder to follow regulations.

units.zh: 未提交SAR可能导致金融机构面临罚款、监管限制甚至监禁等重大处罚。
units.en: Failure to file a SAR can lead to substantial penalties for the financial institution, including fines, regulatory restrictions, or even imprisonment.

units.zh: 必须遵守所在司法管辖区的法规，因各地法规存在差异。
units.en: Make sure you follow the regulations in your jurisdiction, as regulations vary.

cp_b.title_zh: SAFS案例：因未更新企业风险评估而导致的反洗钱/反恐怖融资失败
cp_b.title_en: SAFS case: AML/CFT failures due to outdated EWRA
cp_b.reason: Human review accepted the P2A boundary after checking the section-level review topic.

units.zh: 新加坡金管局因SAFS未更新企业级风险评估而处以250万新元罚款
units.en: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) took enforcement action against Swiss-Asia Financial Services Pte Ltd (SAFS), imposing a S$2.5 million penalty for AML/CFT violations. The wealth and fund management firm failed to update its enterprise-wide risk assessment (EWRA), despite rapid business expansion over a three-year period. This exposed SAFS to new and increased risks of financial crime.

units.zh: SAFS未更新企业级风险评估，静态风险模型导致未检测的金融犯罪风险
units.en: Failure to conduct EWRA updates: SAFS did not reassess its risk framework despite a significant increase in assets under management and onboarding of high-risk clients. A static risk model exposed the firm to undetected financial crime risks.

units.zh: SAFS客户尽职调查控制薄弱，未对高风险客户进行强化尽职调查
units.en: Weak customer due diligence controls: The firm onboarded high-risk customers without conducting enhanced due diligence, failing to verify sources of wealth or screen ultimate beneficial owners against watchlists.

units.zh: 交易监控系统缺乏风险分层，导致漏报可疑交易和延迟提交可疑交易报告
units.en: Inadequate transaction monitoring controls: The firm’s transaction monitoring system lacked risk segmentation and failed to flag suspicious transactions, leading to missed red flags and delayed suspicious activity reports.

units.zh: 高级管理层未能确保反洗钱/反恐怖融资控制措施跟上业务扩张步伐
units.en: Management oversight failures: Senior management failed to ensure that AML/CFT controls kept pace with business expansion. The firm lacked riskbased governance and experienced internal audit failures.

units.zh: MAS发现的反洗钱/反恐怖融资违规行为列表
units.en: MAS uncovered the following AML/CFT breaches:

units.zh: 违规行为对公司及其管理人员产生负面影响
units.en: The breaches had a negative impact on the firm’s business and its managers.

units.zh: 新加坡金融管理局除罚款外还要求公司加强反洗钱合规计划并开展独立风险审查
units.en: For example, in addition to imposing the S$2.5 million fine, MAS required the firm to enhance its AML compliance program and conduct independent risk reviews.

units.zh: 声誉损害导致客户撤资和投资者担忧，影响收入和业务增长
units.en: The resulting reputational damage caused client withdrawals and investor concerns, which impacted revenue and business growth.

units.zh: 高级管理层受到正式训诫，强调高管在反洗钱/反恐怖融资监督中的问责制
units.en: Senior management was officially reprimanded, highlighting the need for executive accountability in AML/CFT oversight.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Typical AFC Functions in the Second Line of Defense

cp_a.reason: Units define the FIU function and classify its two analysis types, forming a foundational review point on FIU mandate.

units.zh: FATF要求各司法辖区设立FIU以接收、分析和传播金融情报
units.en: FATF requires that jurisdictions have FIUs to receive, analyze, and disseminate financial intelligence.

units.zh: 国家FIU开展战略分析和操作分析两种类型的情报分析
units.en: National FIUs produce strategic analysis, which looks at trends and patterns, and operational analysis, which focuses on specific targets.

cp_b.title_zh: 第二道防线典型金融犯罪防控职能
cp_b.title_en: Typical AFC Functions in the Second Line of Defense
cp_b.reason: This section lists typical AFC functions in the second line of defense, which together form a coherent review topic. The introductory and concluding units provide context and support.

units.zh: 数据分析职能识别金融犯罪风险模式与趋势，开发分析模型检测异常和可疑交易。
units.en: In some organizations, the data analytics function sits within the transaction monitoring function. This function identifies financial crime risk patterns and trends. They develop analytical models to detect anomalies and flag fraudulent or suspicious transactions.

units.zh: 模型风险管理职能负责金融犯罪防控模型的验证与治理，包括交易监控系统，确保准确性和合规性。
units.en: The model risk management function is responsible for overseeing the validation and governance of AFC models, including transaction monitoring systems. Such systems evaluate the effectiveness of these models to ensure accuracy and compliance with regulatory standards.

units.zh: 调查职能对可疑活动进行深入调查，收集证据，分析信息，并准备可疑活动报告（SAR）。
units.en: The investigation function conducts in-depth investigations of suspicious activities identified by transaction monitoring or reported by employees. This function gathers evidence, analyzes information, and prepares SARs plus internal and external reports.

units.zh: 政策管理职能制定、维护和更新金融犯罪防控政策与程序，确保合规并管理文档变更。
units.en: The policies management function develops, maintains, and updates AFC policies and procedures to ensure compliance with evolving regulations. This function collaborates with other departments to implement policies, manage document control, and change management.

units.zh: 监管报告与联络职能提交SAR和货币交易报告（CTR），并与监管机构沟通确保准确及时提交。
units.en: The regulatory reporting and liaison function files the required regulatory reports, such as SARs and currency transaction reports (CTR). This function liaises with regulatory authorities to ensure accurate, timely submissions and acts as a point of contact for regulatory audits and inquiries.

units.zh: 合规测试职能对金融犯罪防控控制进行定期质量保证（QA）审查，识别合规差距并建议纠正措施。
units.en: The compliance testing function conducts periodic QA of AFC controls and reviews testing to assess their effectiveness. This function identifies compliance gaps and recommends corrective actions.

units.zh: 洗钱报告官（MLRO）/《银行保密法》（《银行保密法》）官员监督反洗钱（反洗钱）计划，报告可疑活动并确保合规。
units.en: The MLRO/BSA officer oversees the AML program, reports suspicious activities to authorities, and ensures AML regulations compliance. This role coordinates with various functions to maintain organizational compliance.

units.zh: 全球性组织的子公司管理职能确保子公司遵守母公司政策和当地法规，提供支持、指导和审计。
units.en: Global organizations have a subsidiary management function that ensures subsidiaries comply with parent company policies and jurisdiction-specific regulations. This function provides support, guidance, and audits to assess AFC programs in subsidiaries.

units.zh: 第二道防线金融犯罪防控职能由多个专门领域组成，各有特定结构、角色与职责。
units.en: The second line of defense in AFC consists of various functions, each specializing in distinct compliance and risk management areas. Each function has specific structures, roles, and responsibilities.

units.zh: 第二道防线金融犯罪防控职能的结构取决于组织的规模、复杂性、地理覆盖和历史因素。
units.en: How an organization structures its second-line AFC function depends on its size, complexity, geographic reach, and legacy.

units.zh: 列出第二道防线中典型的金融犯罪防控职能。
units.en: The following is a list of typical AFC functions found within the second line of defense.

units.zh: 第二道防线金融犯罪防控职能通过协作主动识别、评估和缓释金融犯罪风险，维护合规框架。
units.en: Each of these functions plays a critical role in ensuring that the second line of defense AFC structure proactively identifies, assesses, and mitigates financial crime risks. By collaborating, they maintain a strong compliance framework that meets regulatory requirements and protects the integrity of the financial system.

units.zh: 社会工程学是网络犯罪手段之一
units.en: Social engineering

units.zh: 网络犯罪使用钓鱼和欺骗等冒充手段
units.en: Impersonation methods such as phishing and spoofing

units.zh: 网络犯罪安装恶意软件如木马和勒索软件
units.en: Installation of malicious software such as malware and ransomware

units.zh: 网络犯罪分子利用信任，结合紧迫性和来源可靠性实施欺骗
units.en: Cybercriminals can use deceptive practices, together or separately, depending upon the intended outcome of the criminal scheme. These techniques can be successful only when the cybercriminal has earned the target’s trust. Whether it is to obtain sensitive information from a target or to convince the target to click on a fraudulent link, cybercriminals must create a combination of urgency and source reliability.

units.zh: 恶意程序在间谍、破坏或勒索意图下感染目标操作系统
units.en: When the intention of the criminal scheme is to spy, corrupt, or extort, the installed malicious computer programs can infect the target’s operating system.

units.zh: 网络犯罪的基础是信任，列举常用手段

cp_b.title_en: Criminal Use of AI and the Technological Race
cp_b.reason: Distinct topic on how criminals leverage AI for synthetic identities and deepfakes, creating a technological race that pressures institutions to stay ahead.

units.zh: 犯罪集团利用AI技术制造合成身份和深度伪造，机构需在技术竞赛中保持领先
units.en: As financial crime prevention has evolved, so have criminals. Many organized crime groups use sophisticated AI-based technology and innovative techniques to produce synthetic identities and deepfakes and to get around AML controls. This technological race has made it even more imperative that organizations consider how they can stay ahead of criminals.
